quranTranslation.text: And we straitened Pharaoh's folk with famine and dearth of fruits, that peradventure they might heed.

explanation.bs: „I Mi smo faraonov rod pogodili godinama suše i nestašicom plodova.“
explanation.en: “And we straitened Pharaoh's folk with famine [literally: the years] and dearth of fruits.”

quranTranslation.text: He said: Ye shall sow seven years as usual, but that which ye reap, leave it in the ear, all save a little which ye eat.

explanation.bs: „Sijat ćete sedam godina uzastopno“ – سِنِين i za godine sjetve: sklonost, ne pravilo.
explanation.en: “Ye shall sow seven years as usual” — sinīn for years of sowing too: a tendency, not a rule.

quranTranslation.text: Then, after that, will come a year when the people will have plenteous crops and when they will press (wine and oil).

explanation.bs: „Zatim će poslije toga doći godina u kojoj će ljudi dobiti kišu i u kojoj će cijediti.“
explanation.en: “Then, after that, will come a year when the people will have plenteous crops and when they will press (wine and oil).”

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! The idolaters only are unclean. So let them not come near the Inviolable Place of Worship after this their year. If ye fear poverty (from the loss of their merchandise) Allah shall preserve you of His bounty if He will. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.

explanation.bs: „Neka se, dakle, poslije ove svoje godine ne približuju Časnom mesdžidu“ – عَام bez ikakve oznake obilja.
explanation.en: “So let them not come near the Inviolable Place of Worship after this their year” — عَام with no sense of plenty.

quranTranslation.text: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.

explanation.bs: „I rano ujutro ih je, doista, zadesila kazna trajna“ – riječ stoji sama, bez para za večer.
explanation.en: “And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning” — the word stands alone, without an evening pair.

quranTranslation.text: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.

explanation.bs: „I spominji ime Gospodara svoga u rano jutro i u predvečerje.“
explanation.en: “Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.”

quranTranslation.text: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.

explanation.bs: Stanovnici Dženneta: „… i u njemu će imati opskrbu svoju ujutro i navečer.“
explanation.en: The people of Paradise: “… and therein they have food for morn and evening.”

quranTranslation.text: And do thou (O Muhammad) remember thy Lord within thyself humbly and with awe, below thy breath, at morn and evening. And be not thou of the neglectful.

explanation.bs: „I u sebi spominji Gospodara svoga, skrušeno i sa strepnjom, bez glasnih riječi, u jutra i u predvečerja“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj par.
explanation.en: “And do thou (O Muhammad) remember thy Lord within thyself humbly and with awe, below thy breath, at morn and evening” — ar-Rāġib cites this pair.

quranTranslation.text: And unto Solomon (We gave) the wind, whereof the morning course was a month's journey and the evening course a month's journey, and We caused the fount of copper to gush forth for him, and (We gave him) certain of the jinn who worked before him by permission of his Lord. And such of them as deviated from Our command, them We caused to taste the punishment of flaming Fire.

explanation.bs: „A Sulejmanu – vjetar: jutarnji mu je pohod trajao mjesec dana, i večernji mjesec dana“ – jutarnji pohod; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And unto Solomon (We gave) the wind, whereof the morning course was a month's journey and the evening course a month's journey” — the morning's journey; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening; and on the day when the Hour upriseth (it is said): Cause Pharaoh's folk to enter the most awful doom.

explanation.bs: Faraonovi ljudi: „Vatra – pred nju bivaju izvedeni jutrom i predvečer.“
explanation.en: Pharaoh's people: “The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening.”

quranTranslation.text: And surely We shall try you with something of fear and hunger, and loss of wealth and lives and crops; but give glad tidings to the steadfast,

explanation.bs: „I Mi ćemo vas sigurno iskušati ponečim od straha i gladi, i gubitkom imetka, života i plodova.“
explanation.en: “And surely We shall try you with something of fear and hunger, and loss of wealth and lives and crops.”

quranTranslation.text: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.

explanation.bs: „Koji ih je nahranio u gladi i od straha ih osigurao.“
explanation.en: “Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.”

quranTranslation.text: Allah coineth a similitude: a township that dwelt secure and well content, its provision coming to it in abundance from every side, but it disbelieved in Allah's favours, so Allah made it experience the garb of dearth and fear because of what they used to do.

explanation.bs: Grad koji je bio nezahvalan na Allahovim blagodatima: „… pa mu je Allah dao da okusi odjeću gladi i straha – za ono što su radili.“
explanation.en: The town that was ungrateful for Allah's favours: “… so Allah made it experience the garb of dearth [literally: hunger] and fear because of what they used to do.”

quranTranslation.text: Forbidden unto you (for food) are carrion and blood and swineflesh, and that which hath been dedicated unto any other than Allah, and the strangled, and the dead through beating, and the dead through falling from a height, and that which hath been killed by (the goring of) horns, and the devoured of wild beasts, saving that which ye make lawful (by the death-stroke), and that which hath been immolated unto idols. And (forbidden is it) that ye swear by the divining arrows. This is an abomination. This day are those who disbelieve in despair of (ever harming) your religion; so fear them not, fear Me! This day have I perfected your religion for you and completed My favour unto you, and have chosen for you as religion al-Islam. Whoso is forced by hunger, not by will, to sin: (for him) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „A ko bude primoran gladovanjem, ne naginjući grijehu – pa Allah, zaista, prašta i milostiv je“ – ar-Rāġib navodi riječi ‚fī maḫmaṣa‘.
explanation.en: “Whoso is forced by hunger [fī maḫmaṣa: in emaciating hunger], not by will, to sin: (for him) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful” — ar-Rāġib cites the words ‘fī maḫmaṣa’.

quranTranslation.text: It is not for the townsfolk of Al-Madinah and for those around them of the wandering Arabs so stay behind the messenger of Allah and prefer their lives to his life. That is because neither thirst nor toil nor hunger afflicteth them in the way of Allah, nor step they any step that angereth the disbelievers, nor gain they from the enemy a gain, but a good deed is recorded for them therefor. Lo! Allah loseth not the wages of the good.

explanation.bs: Onima koji izađu na Allahovom putu „ne pogađa ih ni žeđ, ni umor, ni gladovanje“, a da im se to ne upiše kao dobro djelo.
explanation.en: Those who go out in the cause of Allah: “neither thirst nor toil nor hunger [maḫmaṣa: emaciating hunger] afflicteth them”, but that a good deed is recorded for them by it.

quranTranslation.text: And to feed in the day of hunger.

explanation.bs: „Ili dati hrane u dan gladi koja iscrpljuje“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And to feed in the day of hunger [masġaba: exhausting hunger]” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Then Zachariah prayed unto his Lord and said: My Lord! Bestow upon me of Thy bounty goodly offspring. Lo! Thou art the Hearer of Prayer.

explanation.bs: Zekerijja: „Gospodaru moj, daruj mi od Sebe dobro potomstvo; Ti, doista, čuješ dovu.“
explanation.en: Zechariah: “My Lord! Bestow upon me of Thy bounty goodly offspring. Lo! Thou art the Hearer of Prayer.”

quranTranslation.text: And let those fear (in their behaviour toward orphans) who if they left behind them weak offspring would be afraid for them. So let them mind their duty to Allah, and speak justly.

explanation.bs: „Neka se boje oni koji bi strahovali za svoje nejako potomstvo kad bi ga iza sebe ostavili.“
explanation.en: “And let those fear (in their behaviour toward orphans) who if they left behind them weak offspring would be afraid for them.”

quranTranslation.text: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.

explanation.bs: „A one koji vjeruju i čije ih potomstvo u vjerovanju slijedi – njima ćemo pridružiti potomstvo njihovo.“
explanation.en: “And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them.”

quranTranslation.text: And when he turneth away (from thee) his effort in the land is to make mischief therein and to destroy the crops and the cattle; and Allah loveth not mischief.

explanation.bs: „A kad se okrene, trudi se po Zemlji da u njoj nered čini i da upropaštava usjeve i porod – a Allah nered ne voli“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet; mnogi mufessiri: porod ljudi i životinja.
explanation.en: “And when he turneth away (from thee) his effort in the land is to make mischief therein and to destroy the crops and the cattle [an-nasl: the progeny]; and Allah loveth not mischief” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah; many mufassirun: the young of people and of animals.

quranTranslation.text: Then He made his seed from a draught of despised fluid;

explanation.bs: „Zatim je porod njegov učinio od izvatka bezvrijedne tekućine.“
explanation.en: “Then He made his seed from a draught of despised fluid.”
